b2_plus.prompt: A team says, "We should be able to deliver next week, assuming no additional scope." Which description fits?
options: A firm commitment next week, with added scope affecting quality rather than the delivery date.
A reasonably confident forecast conditional on unchanged scope.
A forecast that includes expected additional scope within the same delivery window.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Should be able to выражает ожидаемую возможность; assuming указывает условие прогноза, а не абсолютное обязательство.
b2_plus.target_construction: Give a calibrated delivery forecast and state its assumptions.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a stakeholder. You expect a report on Monday if the source file arrives unchanged tomorrow; state the assumption and when you will reassess.
Write 2-4 sentences to a release lead. A migration likely fits the weekend window if the rehearsal shows no unexpected errors; communicate confidence and its condition.

c1_intro.prompt: A security team can review a questionnaire by Friday, but approval depends on its contents. A buyer wants “approval by Friday” in the schedule. Which wording commits only to the controllable step?
options: We commit to approval by Friday, provided the review takes place as scheduled.
We expect approval by Friday because completing the review is the only remaining step.
We commit to completing the review by Friday; approval will depend on the findings.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Срок проверки контролируется командой, итог зависит от содержания. Остальные ответы превращают завершение процесса в достаточное условие положительного решения.
c1_intro.target_construction: Separate a controllable process commitment from an outcome that remains conditional.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a buyer. Your team can submit a security questionnaire by Friday, but cannot promise the buyer will approve it then; state the commitment precisely.
Write 2-4 sentences to a programme board. Engineers can complete a benchmark next week, but cannot guarantee it will meet the performance target; distinguish the two promises.

b2.prompt: A requirement says users must be able to download invoices in PDF format. Which acceptance check directly tests it?
options: Check that a user can download an invoice as a PDF.
Check that a user can view an invoice online, without trying a download.
Check that a user can download an invoice in any format except PDF.
b2.explanation_ru: Критерий приёмки проверяет заданное действие и формат, а не внешнюю деталь интерфейса или другую функцию.
b2.target_construction: Translate a requirement into a concrete acceptance criterion.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a requirements note. Customers must reset passwords without contacting support; state the behaviour and a testable acceptance check.
Write 2-4 sentences for a technical ticket. Analysts must export filtered results as CSV; specify the expected behaviour and what a tester should verify.

b2_plus.prompt: A change request says, "Add reminders only for orders that remain unpaid after seven days." Which orders should receive reminders?
options: Orders that were unpaid at creation, even if payment arrives within seven days.
Orders still unpaid once the seven-day period has passed.
Orders due for payment within the next seven days, before their status becomes overdue.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Only for и that remain unpaid вместе ограничивают множество; after seven days задаёт временное условие.
b2_plus.target_construction: Specify a change using precise eligibility and timing conditions.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a client change request. Send renewal notices only to active contracts expiring within thirty days; make both eligibility conditions explicit.
Write 2-4 sentences for an engineering ticket. Alert on jobs that have failed twice consecutively, while successful retries should clear the count; specify the conditions.

c1_intro.prompt: New accounts are in scope; legacy migration requires an approved change. A client adds legacy migration to their notes but submits no change request. Which response applies the scope rule constructively?
options: Your notes record the migration need, so we can treat it as provisionally included pending approval.
Because legacy migration is excluded, assessing it would itself exceed the approved scope.
We can assess legacy migration through change control; the current scope still covers new accounts only.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Запись пожелания не является одобрением, но наличие исключения не запрещает оценить новый запрос через установленный процесс.
c1_intro.target_construction: Define a default scope boundary and the authorised exception process.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a client. The current work covers new accounts, while migrating legacy accounts requires a separately approved change; clarify the boundary and route.

Write 2-4 sentences for a release specification. Offline access is excluded from this release unless the steering group approves added scope; communicate the exclusion without implying permanent impossibility.

b2.prompt: You are investigating why a client wants a new dashboard. Which question asks about the problem before prescribing a solution?
options: Which decisions are difficult with the information you have today?
Which colour would you prefer for the dashboard we have already selected?
Which dashboard package would you like to order today?
b2.explanation_ru: Открытый вопрос исследует трудность и нужный результат, не навязывая продукт как уже доказанное решение.
b2.target_construction: Ask an open discovery question about a customer’s current problem.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a client who requests automated email. Ask what currently causes delays and what improvement would matter, without assuming automation is the answer.
Write 2-4 sentences to a team requesting a search tool. Ask which information is hard to find and how that affects their work before recommending technology.

b2_plus.prompt: A client says, "We need faster reports." You need their own timing target and the decision it supports. Which open follow-up asks for both without suggesting a target?
options: Which reporting tool would give you the quickest improvement?
How quickly do you need the reports, and which decision depends on that timing?
Would receiving the same report one day sooner meet your needs?
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Вопрос уточняет измеримый срок и его практическую цель; faster без ориентира не даёт критерия успеха.
b2_plus.target_construction: Turn a broad customer need into a measurable, decision-relevant outcome.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a customer who wants “better support.” Ask about current response times and what response target would improve their operation.
Write 2-4 sentences to a user who wants “easier onboarding.” Ask which step causes difficulty and what successful completion would look like.

c1_intro.prompt: A client asks for more data fields. In discussion, they say duplicate records prevent reliable reconciliation. Which next question tests the relationship between the proposed feature and the underlying need?
options: Which extra fields should we prioritise so the reconciliation problem is addressed first?
Would deduplication be preferable, since the request for extra fields does not reflect the real need?
What would the extra fields let you reconcile that you cannot reconcile with the current records?
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Верный вопрос проверяет связь полей с потребностью без принятия или отвержения решения. Prioritise предполагает, что поля уже решают проблему, а does not reflect the real need преждевременно объявляет просьбу ошибочной.
c1_intro.target_construction: Test whether a requested solution represents the customer’s underlying need.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a client requesting more data fields. Their staff actually struggle to reconcile duplicate records; explore the underlying outcome without dismissing their suggestion.
Write 2-4 sentences to a customer asking for weekly training. Users forget a rarely used workflow; ask whether reference guidance or training best addresses the difficulty.

b2.prompt: A client spends two hours each week copying figures. Your proposed import removes that manual copying. Which benefit statement is supported?
options: The import could reduce the time spent copying figures manually.
The import could make the manual copying screen more colourful.
The import will remove all manual work across the client’s business.
b2.explanation_ru: Заявленная ценность связана с конкретным текущим действием; could избегает неподтверждённой гарантии всех экономических эффектов.
b2.target_construction: Connect a proposed feature to a concrete customer benefit.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a client. A searchable invoice archive may reduce time spent requesting old invoices; link the capability to their current difficulty.
Write 2-4 sentences for an internal proposal. Automated test summaries may reduce manual status gathering; explain the benefit and who would use it.

b2_plus.prompt: A proposal says, "In the pilot, preparation time fell by 25%; results may vary with workflow." Which sales summary is justified?
options: The pilot establishes 25% as a reasonable minimum reduction for similar customer workflows.
The pilot showed a 25% reduction, with the effect dependent on workflow.
Workflow differences explain why the reduction cannot count as useful pilot evidence.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: In the pilot ограничивает наблюдение, may vary запрещает переносить точный результат как универсальную гарантию.
b2_plus.target_construction: Use pilot evidence persuasively while preserving its limits.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a buyer. A trial with one team reduced re-entry errors from ten to six per week; cite the result and propose testing their own workflow.
Write 2-4 sentences to a sponsor. In one service, a new dashboard cut investigation time from forty to thirty minutes; present the evidence without promising identical gains elsewhere.

c1_intro.prompt: A simpler tool has fewer features than a rival but could remove a recurring five-hour task. The buyer values effort saved, and actual use is not yet tested. Which recommendation fits both the criterion and the uncertainty?
options: Prefer the simpler tool, because removing one five-hour task outweighs any unused rival features.
Compare feature coverage first, using the five-hour saving to break a tie between equally capable tools.
Compare the task effort each tool could remove, and validate that users would realise that saving.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Оценка начинается со значимого результата и проверяет его достижимость. Prefer the simpler tool заранее ранжирует неизвестные альтернативы, а feature coverage first ставит функции выше заявленного критерия.
c1_intro.target_construction: Frame value in terms of relevant outcomes and opportunity cost rather than feature volume.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a procurement team. A simpler tool has fewer features but could remove a recurring five-hour reconciliation task; argue for an outcome-based evaluation.
Write 2-4 sentences to an executive sponsor. A reporting service adds no new charts but could eliminate duplicate manual checks; explain how to assess its value and an assumption to verify.

b2.prompt: A supplier offers a 5% discount if the order reaches 100 units. The buyer orders 80. Which statement is correct under that offer?
options: The 80-unit order does not meet the discount condition.
The 80-unit order qualifies because the threshold is a maximum of 100.
The order qualifies because a discount applies only below 100 units.
b2.explanation_ru: If устанавливает порог количества; 80 меньше 100, поэтому именно это условие скидки не выполнено.
b2.target_construction: Explain a commercial condition and whether a proposed order meets it.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a customer. Free delivery applies to orders of at least £200, while their order totals £170; explain the condition and ask whether they want to adjust the order.
Write 2-4 sentences to a supplier. Extended support is included for contracts of twelve months, but you need six; ask what terms would apply.

b2_plus.prompt: A buyer says, "If you can extend support to twelve months, we can agree to the longer contract." What is offered?
options: A longer contract now, with extended support to be negotiated afterwards.
A longer contract in exchange for extended support.
Extended support as a preference that does not affect agreement to the longer contract.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: If ... we can задаёт условную уступку: согласие на срок связано с изменением поддержки.
b2_plus.target_construction: Make a conditional concession and name the reciprocal benefit.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a vendor. You can accept annual billing if they include two onboarding sessions; propose the exchange clearly.
Write 2-4 sentences to a client. You can reserve an extra implementation day if they confirm the schedule this week; state the conditional concession.

c1_intro.prompt: A supplier grants a one-time training credit for this rollout and expressly excludes future pricing precedent. A buyer asks to include the credit in their standard renewal terms. Which reply preserves the agreement’s scope?
options: The credit can guide renewal pricing, although the amount may be reviewed separately.
Renewal terms must exclude any training credit because the current agreement sets no precedent.
The credit covers this rollout; renewal training terms would need a separate agreement.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Нет автоматического права на повторение, но возможны отдельные переговоры. Guide renewal pricing вводит прецедент, must exclude превращает отсутствие прецедента в запрет будущей уступки.
c1_intro.target_construction: Limit a negotiated exception without implying a standing entitlement.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a buyer. You offer a one-time training credit for the current rollout, while future training remains separately priced; define the exception’s scope.
Write 2-4 sentences to a supplier. You accept a later delivery for one shipment, while the standard deadline remains for future shipments; clarify the limited waiver.

b2.prompt: A customer cannot sign in. Support has received the issue but has not fixed it yet. Which reply is accurate and helpful?
options: I understand this is disruptive. We are investigating and will update you by 4 p.m.
I understand this is disruptive. We guarantee the issue will be fixed by 4 p.m.
We resolved your sign-in issue and are now closing the investigation.
b2.explanation_ru: Ответ признаёт влияние проблемы, сообщает действительный статус и обещает обновление, не выдумывая устранение.
b2.target_construction: Acknowledge a customer’s difficulty and provide an honest next update.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a customer whose export failed. The cause is still being investigated; acknowledge the disruption and promise a status update tomorrow morning.
Write 2-4 sentences to an internal user whose access request is delayed. Explain that approval is pending and name the next update time without promising access yet.

b2_plus.prompt: A support note says, "The workaround restores access, but the underlying fault remains under investigation." Which update retains both facts?
options: Access is restored, so investigation now concerns only preventing unrelated future faults.
Users can regain access through the workaround while the cause is still being investigated.
The underlying fault must be fixed before users can benefit from the workaround.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Workaround восстанавливает функцию временным способом; underlying fault remains отделяет это от устранения причины.
b2_plus.target_construction: Distinguish a temporary workaround from resolution of the underlying issue.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a client. Downloading through a backup link works, but the normal export button is still broken; explain the workaround and unresolved fault.
Write 2-4 sentences to a support channel. Restarting a worker clears the queue temporarily, but repeated stalls are being analysed; distinguish recovery from a permanent fix.

c1_intro.prompt: Two workarounds have temporarily reduced client errors, but recurrence continues and no investigator is assigned. Which escalation requests accountability without overstating what the workarounds establish?
options: Please assign an owner to confirm the workarounds fixed the fault and explain why errors returned.
Please promise permanent recovery at the next update so the client has an accountable outcome.
Please assign an investigation owner and next update; temporary recovery has not resolved the recurring fault.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Ответ просит владельца процесса и обновление, опираясь на продолжающийся сбой. Остальные ответы требуют подтверждения недоказанного исправления или гарантии неизвестного результата.
c1_intro.target_construction: Escalate an unresolved issue by requesting accountable action and evidence.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a service manager. A client’s repeated billing errors have no assigned investigator; request ownership, a next step and an update deadline without alleging negligence.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineering lead. Intermittent timeouts persist after two temporary fixes; escalate the need for a named investigation owner and an evidence-based plan.

b2.prompt: Weekly registrations rose from 200 to 240. Which statement describes the change?
options: Registrations increased by 40, reaching 240.
Registrations increased by 240, from a starting value of 200.
Registrations increased to 40, from a starting value of 200.
b2.explanation_ru: By обозначает величину изменения (40), to / reaching — конечный уровень (240); их нельзя взаимозаменять.
b2.target_construction: Distinguish the size of a change from its final value.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a customer update. Monthly completed orders rose from 120 to 150; report the starting value, increase and final value clearly.
Write 2-4 sentences for an engineering report. Failed requests fell from 90 to 60 per hour after a change; describe the direction and size without claiming causation.

b2_plus.prompt: A conversion rate rose from 10% to 12%. Which statement expresses the difference in percentage points?
options: The rate rose by twenty percentage points.
The rate rose by two percentage points.
The rate rose by two percent relative to its original level.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: 12% − 10% = два процентных пункта; относительный рост составляет 20%, а не 2%.
b2_plus.target_construction: Differentiate percentage-point changes from relative percentage changes.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a marketing lead. A response rate increased from 20% to 25%; describe the percentage-point change and keep it distinct from relative growth.
Write 2-4 sentences for a service review. The error rate fell from 4% to 3%; explain the percentage-point difference and the direction of the change.

c1_intro.prompt: Average resolution time fell from two days to one, while complex cases rose from five days to seven. Leaders propose reporting “support improved.” Which summary most fairly represents the distribution?
options: The improved average indicates broad improvement, with complex cases as a minor exception.
The worsening complex cases outweigh the average improvement, so support performance declined overall.
Overall resolution became faster on average, but complex cases worsened and need separate attention.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Два показателя нужно сообщить отдельно. Размер и важность группы не даны, поэтому minor exception и overall declined необоснованно ранжируют эффекты.
c1_intro.target_construction: Explain why an aggregate metric can conceal an important subgroup or tail trend.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a leadership update. Average support resolution fell from two days to one, while complex cases rose from five days to seven; report both trends.
Write 2-4 sentences for an engineering review. Median latency fell, but the 99th-percentile latency increased; explain the limit of the positive headline without inventing causes.

b2.prompt: The budget allows £3,000 for equipment and £1,000 for training. Equipment actually costs £3,200. Which statement describes the equipment line?
options: Equipment is £200 over its allocated budget.
Equipment is £800 under its own £3,000 allocation.
Equipment is exactly on its allocated budget, since training funds exist.
b2.explanation_ru: Over its allocated budget означает превышение конкретной статьи: 3200 − 3000 = 200; общий бюджет не отменяет этого факта.
b2.target_construction: Report an actual cost against the allocation for the relevant budget line.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a project manager. Travel was allocated £900 and now costs £1,050; state the variance and ask how to handle it.
Write 2-4 sentences for a team budget review. Cloud services were allocated £800 and cost £720 this month; report the remaining amount without assuming it can be freely reassigned.

b2_plus.prompt: A manager says, "We have enough funding, but not enough staff time." What is the limiting resource?
options: The budget earmarked for staff time, rather than staff availability itself.
Available staff capacity rather than money.
Available money and staff time jointly, since funding cannot be used without staff.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Enough funding снимает денежное ограничение; not enough staff time прямо называет дефицит мощности команды.
b2_plus.target_construction: Identify the binding resource constraint instead of treating all resources as interchangeable.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a sponsor. Funding is approved for training, but the only trainer is booked all month; explain the constraint and propose a scheduling option.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineering manager. The tool budget is sufficient, but migration requires specialist hours that are unavailable; explain what resource decision is needed.

c1_intro.prompt: A £30,000 renewal moves from December to January at the same price. This year’s spend falls, but the service remains necessary. Which explanation should accompany the budget figure?
options: The reduced current-year spend is a saving, although next year’s budget will absorb the renewal.
The unchanged renewal price means the move has no effect on the current-year budget position.
The current-year reduction reflects payment timing, rather than a lower total obligation.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Перенос улучшает показатель периода, не уменьшая стоимость обязательства. Saving смешивает момент и сумму, no effect игнорирует изменение текущего бюджета.
c1_intro.target_construction: Separate a timing effect in a budget from a genuine reduction in total expenditure.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a finance partner. Moving a software renewal from December to January improves this year’s spend figure but leaves the fee unchanged; explain the effect.
Write 2-4 sentences for a programme update. Equipment purchases are postponed to next quarter, with the same units and prices still required; distinguish cash timing from overall savings.

b2.prompt: A project brings £12,000 in revenue and costs £9,000 in total. Which statement describes the difference using these figures?
options: Revenue exceeds total cost by £3,000.
Total cost exceeds revenue by £3,000.
Revenue exceeds total cost by £12,000.
b2.explanation_ru: Exceeds by выражает разницу двух величин: 12000 − 9000 = 3000. Доход и затраты не равны.
b2.target_construction: Compare revenue and stated costs without confusing the two.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a fictional business case. A workshop earns £6,000 and has £4,500 in total costs; describe the difference and state that these are the given assumptions.
Write 2-4 sentences to a project sponsor. A proposed service produces £8,000 in monthly revenue against £7,200 in stated monthly costs; describe the projected margin cautiously.

b2_plus.prompt: An investment costs £20,000 upfront and is expected to save £5,000 a year, with no other costs assumed. Which simple payback estimate follows?
options: Four years, even if actual annual savings differ from the estimate.
Four years, if the expected annual saving is achieved.
Five years, because the upfront investment must be added to the first year’s savings.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: 20 000 / 5 000 = четыре года; expected и условие сохраняют зависимость расчёта от фактической экономии.
b2_plus.target_construction: Explain a simple payback estimate and its stated assumptions.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a budget committee. An £18,000 system is projected to save £6,000 annually with no extra costs assumed; state the simple payback and a condition to verify.
Write 2-4 sentences for an internal proposal. A £10,000 automation is expected to avoid £2,500 of annual manual work; explain the estimated payback without treating the saving as guaranteed.

c1_intro.prompt: A platform is cheap to implement, but the projected return assumes most staff use it weekly. Adoption has not been tested. Which statement gives a defensible recommendation?
options: Low implementation cost makes the return likely even if weekly adoption falls below the assumed level.
Untested adoption makes the low cost irrelevant until the projected return is proven.
Low implementation cost is favourable, but the return still needs validation against likely adoption.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Стоимость остаётся плюсом, а возврат зависит от непроверенного использования. Likely even if ослабляет условие без расчёта, а low cost irrelevant отбрасывает самостоятельный фактор стоимости.
c1_intro.target_construction: Qualify an investment case by explaining the behavioural assumption behind its projected return.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a sponsor. A training platform is inexpensive, but savings assume most staff use it weekly; explain the adoption dependency and suggest evidence to monitor.
Write 2-4 sentences to a finance reviewer. Automated invoicing is installed, but the business case assumes clients switch from manual requests; explain why installation alone is insufficient.

b2.prompt: A team plans to interview customers to understand why renewals are falling. Which sentence distinguishes the action from its purpose?
options: We will interview customers to understand the decline in renewals.
We will interview customers because the decline has already been fully explained.
We aim to increase the number of interviews, regardless of what we learn about renewals.
b2.explanation_ru: To understand выражает цель действия interview; метод исследования не подменяет ожидаемое понимание.
b2.target_construction: Connect a strategic activity to the outcome it is intended to achieve.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a strategy note. A company will study lost bids to understand which customer needs it misses; describe the activity and purpose.
Write 2-4 sentences to a leadership team. An internal platform group plans user interviews before expanding its service; connect the research to a decision it should inform.

b2_plus.prompt: A strategy says, "We will prioritise retention over acquisition this quarter." Which choice follows that emphasis?
options: Keep current customers as the exclusive focus, suspending all acquisition work for the quarter.
Give greater attention to keeping current customers than to winning new ones.
Give equal attention to retention and acquisition, prioritising whichever is cheaper.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Prioritise ... over устанавливает относительный приоритет, не обязательно отменяя второе направление полностью.
b2_plus.target_construction: Explain a relative strategic priority without turning it into an absolute exclusion.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a commercial team. This quarter emphasises improving existing customers’ experience while new sales continue at a smaller scale; explain the priority.
Write 2-4 sentences to a platform team. Reliability work takes priority over new features this month, though critical feature fixes remain possible; state the focus and boundary.

c1_intro.prompt: Moderate growth is the base case. Rapid growth is plausible and would require extra capacity, but is not the most expected outcome. Which planning statement distinguishes the scenarios?
options: Plan core capacity for rapid growth, since a plausible scenario should replace the moderate forecast.
Keep planning to the base case; capacity for rapid growth should be considered only after it occurs.
Plan core capacity for moderate growth and define a contingency if rapid growth materialises.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Base case задаёт основной план, plausible scenario — предусмотренную альтернативу. Возможность не заменяет прогноз и не требует игнорировать подготовку к риску.
c1_intro.target_construction: Distinguish a contingency scenario from the organisation’s central forecast.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to an executive team. A competitor may cut prices sharply, but this is a contingency scenario rather than the central forecast; explain how to prepare without presenting it as certain.
Write 2-4 sentences for a planning document. Rapid user growth is possible, while moderate growth is the base case; distinguish the scenarios and one capacity implication.

b2.prompt: In an interview, you describe a completed project last year. Which sentence fits that finished time?
options: Last year I led a project that reduced reporting delays.
Last year I have led a project that reduced reporting delays.
Last year I had been leading the project that will first begin next month.
b2.explanation_ru: Last year задаёт завершённое прошлое, поэтому led подходит для рассказа о конкретном законченном проекте.
b2.target_construction: Describe a completed professional example with a clear action and outcome.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a fictional interview answer. Last year you reorganised a help page and reduced repeated questions; describe the situation, your action and result.
Write 2-4 sentences for a fictional interview answer. In a previous project you created deployment instructions that reduced setup mistakes; identify your contribution.

b2_plus.prompt: A candidate says, "I proposed the approach; my colleagues and I implemented it together." Which summary preserves responsibility?
options: The candidate supervised implementation without contributing to it personally.
The candidate originated the approach but shares implementation credit with the team.
The team originated the approach and the candidate implemented it on their behalf.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Два глагола распределяют вклад: proposed — личная инициатива, implemented together — совместное исполнение.
b2_plus.target_construction: State your individual contribution while giving accurate credit for collective results.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for an interview. You identified a duplicate-data problem and proposed checks; colleagues built the checks with you. Describe your role without claiming their work.
Write 2-4 sentences for a promotion statement. You designed a customer workshop outline, while two teammates delivered sessions; distinguish leadership from shared execution.

c1_intro.prompt: A rollout met its deadline, but late documentation strained support. Asked what you would change, which answer reflects critically without rewriting the outcome?
options: The deadline success suggests the documentation timing was an acceptable compromise overall.
The support strain means I should describe the rollout as unsuccessful despite meeting the date.
We met the date, but I would involve support earlier so documentation did not become a late burden.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Ответ сохраняет успех по сроку и конкретный урок процесса. Остальные оценивают весь результат одним показателем, вместо того чтобы различить достижение и недостаток.
c1_intro.target_construction: Reflect critically on a successful experience without exaggerating failure or claiming perfection.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for an interview. A fictional rollout met its deadline, but late documentation strained support; describe the success and what you would change next time.
Write 2-4 sentences for a career reflection. A client presentation won approval, but you answered technical questions only after the meeting; explain a specific improvement for future preparation.

b2.prompt: You observed that a colleague sent two reports after the agreed deadlines. Which feedback starts with an observation rather than a personality judgement?
options: The last two reports arrived after the agreed deadlines.
You clearly do not care about meeting deadlines.
You must be deliberately delaying our reports.
b2.explanation_ru: Конкретное наблюдение проверяемо и относится к работе; глобальные характеристики личности не следуют из двух эпизодов.
b2.target_construction: Give feedback using a specific observable behaviour.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague. Their last presentation had unreadably small chart labels; describe the observation, its effect and a useful change.
Write 2-4 sentences to a teammate. Two recent handovers omitted the next action owner; describe the pattern and ask for that detail in future notes.

b2_plus.prompt: A manager says, "I noticed the updates became less frequent; is something making them difficult?" What approach is used?
options: A question that establishes difficulty as the reason before exploring the observation.
An observation followed by a question about possible causes.
An observation that treats fewer updates as evidence of reduced commitment.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: I noticed отделяет наблюдение от интерпретации; вопрос оставляет причины неизвестными вместо приписывания мотива.
b2_plus.target_construction: Explore the cause of a feedback issue before attributing intent.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a one-to-one. A teammate has missed two planning sessions; state the observation and ask about obstacles without assuming lack of interest.
Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague. Their review comments have recently become very brief; ask whether time pressure or another issue is affecting the reviews.

c1_intro.prompt: A reviewer raises valid risks but labels colleagues “careless.” You want evidence-based criticism and continued risk reporting. Which feedback protects both aims?
options: Avoid raising these risks publicly until the colleagues involved agree with your assessment.
Describe people more gently so the risks can still be raised in their current form.
Keep raising the risks, but describe the evidence and impact instead of labelling the people involved.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Верный ответ меняет способ выражения, не ограничивая содержательные проблемы. Until colleagues agree ставит сообщения в зависимость от согласия, а describe people more gently сохраняет оценивание людей вместо фактов.
c1_intro.target_construction: Set a behavioural expectation while protecting the legitimate purpose behind the behaviour.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague. They correctly identify project risks but interrupt others repeatedly; ask for a different discussion method while encouraging risk reporting.
Write 2-4 sentences for a one-to-one. A reviewer’s objections are useful but use personal labels; request evidence-based wording without discouraging critical review.

b2.prompt: A manager asks Taylor to prepare a draft and says they will review it before sending. Which responsibility belongs to Taylor?
options: Prepare the draft for the manager’s review.
Approve and send the final version before the manager sees it.
Review the manager’s draft instead of preparing one.
b2.explanation_ru: Prepare a draft определяет поручение; review before sending сохраняет отдельный этап контроля у руководителя.
b2.target_construction: Delegate a concrete task and distinguish preparation from approval.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a junior colleague. Ask them to draft a workshop agenda by Wednesday, with final approval retained by you; explain the task and review point.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineer. Ask them to prepare a test plan for your review before execution; name the deliverable, deadline and approval boundary.

b2_plus.prompt: A lead says, "You can choose the method, provided the agreed checks are completed." What autonomy is granted?
options: Freedom to select which agreed checks are relevant to the chosen method.
Freedom over the method within a requirement to complete the checks.
Freedom over the checks, while the lead retains the choice of method.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Can choose даёт свободу, provided задаёт обязательную границу: согласованные проверки остаются.
b2_plus.target_construction: Grant decision freedom within explicit quality or process boundaries.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague organising customer training. They may choose the activities, but must cover three required topics and collect feedback; state the autonomy and limits.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineer. They may choose a refactoring approach, provided public interfaces and performance checks remain intact; delegate the decision clearly.

c1_intro.prompt: A colleague proposes a new follow-up process. You want them to develop judgement, while ensuring the trial has a review point. Which coaching question best supports that combination?
options: Wouldn’t our existing response-time target be the best measure for your trial?
Can you run the trial first and decide later what a successful result would mean?
What result would count as improvement, and when would you have enough evidence to review it?
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Открытый вопрос поручает коллеге определить критерий и достаточность данных до проверки. Wouldn’t ... the best measure подсказывает готовый ответ, а decide later откладывает критерий и допускает подгонку оценки.
c1_intro.target_construction: Use an open coaching question to develop independent judgement and evaluation.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague trying a new customer follow-up process. Ask questions that help them choose a success indicator and a review point, without dictating the solution.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineer proposing a cache change. Ask how they will test the intended benefit and notice regressions, while leaving technical ownership with them.

b2.prompt: A teammate’s short message sounds abrupt to you, but you do not know their intention. Which response avoids assuming hostility?
options: I may have read the tone differently; could you clarify what you meant?
Your message was short, so I know you intended to offend me.
I will report your hostile intention without checking what you meant.
b2.explanation_ru: May have read признаёт возможность собственной ошибки; просьба об уточнении не приписывает мотив и не обобщает культуру.
b2.target_construction: Check perceived tone before assigning intent in a diverse team.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague. Their message “do this today” surprised you because no urgency was explained; ask about the timing and meaning without alleging disrespect.
Write 2-4 sentences to an international teammate. They declined your suggestion with a very short reply; check whether they had a specific concern and keep the tone neutral.

b2_plus.prompt: A colleague says, "Silence in our meeting should not be taken as consent." Which interpretation of silence is explicitly ruled out?
options: Silent participants may have deliberately abstained.
People who did not speak agreed with the decision.
Silent participants may still be considering their response.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Should not be taken as предупреждает об ошибочной интерпретации молчания; явная проверка согласия помогает её избежать.
b2_plus.target_construction: Identify a communication convention and check agreement explicitly.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a facilitator. Several remote colleagues stayed silent during a decision; request a written check of agreement instead of assuming support.
Write 2-4 sentences to a client team. Some participants avoid direct disagreement in large meetings; propose a private or asynchronous way to gather concerns without stereotyping individuals.

c1_intro.prompt: Different expectations about directness contributed to an argument, and one participant used a personal insult. Which mediation statement recognises context while maintaining the shared standard?
options: We should clarify expectations first, then decide whether the insult crossed a boundary for this culture.
Because an insult occurred, differing expectations should play no part in understanding the conflict.
We should clarify expectations about directness while holding everyone to the boundary against personal insults.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Контекст помогает разбору, но не отменяет общую границу. Decide ... for this culture делает её условной, а should play no part отвергает полезное объяснение конфликта.
c1_intro.target_construction: Acknowledge contextual differences without excusing conduct that crosses a shared boundary.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to two colleagues. Different expectations about directness may have contributed to an argument, but one used a personal insult; recognise context and set a respectful boundary.
Write 2-4 sentences for a team agreement. Time-zone and response norms differ, but repeated public mockery is unacceptable; propose a clear expectation and a way to clarify misunderstandings.

b2.prompt: A service receives requests, places them in a queue, and workers process them later. Which explanation preserves that flow?
options: Requests are queued first and processed by workers afterwards.
Requests are processed immediately without entering the queue.
Workers process requests first and queue the completed work afterwards.
b2.explanation_ru: Queued first / processed afterwards сохраняет порядок и использует пассив для описания обработки запросов.
b2.target_construction: Explain a system flow with clear sequence and passive constructions.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a nontechnical colleague. Uploaded files are stored, then scanned, then made available for download; explain the sequence without adding implementation details.
Write 2-4 sentences for an architecture note. Events enter a buffer, a consumer reads them and a report is updated; describe the data flow clearly.

b2_plus.prompt: An architect says, "Caching reduces repeated reads, at the cost of potentially stale data." What trade-off is described?
options: Fewer repeated reads, with outdated data limited to the first read after caching begins.
Fewer repeated reads in exchange for a risk of outdated data.
A risk of stale data offset by a guaranteed reduction in total operating cost.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: At the cost of вводит цену преимущества; potentially сохраняет риск устаревания, не утверждая, что данные всегда устарели.
b2_plus.target_construction: Explain an architectural benefit together with the relevant trade-off.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a product manager. Batch processing lowers overhead but delays visible updates; explain the trade-off and ask which constraint matters more.
Write 2-4 sentences for a design review. Keeping a local copy improves availability but requires synchronisation; explain the advantage and the new responsibility.

c1_intro.prompt: A single database is simpler to operate at modest write volume. The roadmap may bring a tenfold increase, but its timing is uncertain. Which decision note states the recommendation and its operating boundary?
options: Use one database until the roadmap date, since uncertain growth does not alter the simplicity argument.
Adopt a distributed design now, since possible future growth invalidates the present recommendation.
Use one database for current volume, with a review trigger tied to write growth rather than an assumed date.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Текущий выбор действует при конкретной нагрузке, а пересмотр привязан к изменению условия. Возможный рост не отменяет сегодняшнее преимущество и не делает календарную дату достаточным критерием.
c1_intro.target_construction: State the operating assumptions within which an architectural recommendation holds.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for an architecture decision summary. A single database is easier to maintain while write volume remains modest; state the assumption and when the choice should be revisited.
Write 2-4 sentences to a programme lead. A shared service reduces duplication if teams can accept the same release schedule; explain the condition and a situation where the advantage may weaken.

b2.prompt: A procedure requires stopping the worker before editing its configuration. Which instruction is correct?
options: Stop the worker before changing the configuration.
Change the configuration while the worker runs, then stop it.
Stop the worker only if the configuration edit fails.
b2.explanation_ru: Before задаёт требуемый порядок; конкретные глаголы stop / change делают инструкцию исполнимой.
b2.target_construction: Write a precise procedural instruction with a required prerequisite.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences of internal instructions. Before importing a CSV, users must verify its column headers; after import they should check the row count.
Write 2-4 sentences for a handover guide. Before applying a staging configuration, engineers must save the existing configuration; afterwards they should verify service health.

b2_plus.prompt: A document says, "Restart the worker after updating the queue settings. This ensures the new settings are loaded." What does "This" refer to?
options: Updating the queue settings, whether or not the worker is restarted.
Restarting the worker after the update.
The combined update and a restart before the new settings are saved.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: This отсылает к предшествующему действию restart after updating; именно перезапуск загружает новые настройки по описанию.
b2_plus.target_construction: Make a technical reference explicit and explain why a step is required.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a runbook. After renewing a certificate, reload the service so it uses the new certificate; make the action and its purpose explicit.
Write 2-4 sentences for a user guide. After changing a report filter, refresh the preview to see the new selection; avoid an ambiguous reference to “this.”

c1_intro.prompt: Fallback is authorised only when the primary is unavailable. One response was slow, while subsequent health checks pass. Which runbook instruction applies the trigger without treating the slow response as proof?
options: Switch provisionally on the slow response, then use health checks to decide whether to remain on fallback.
Passing health checks rule out unavailability, so the slow response can be removed from investigation.
Verify unavailability before switching; continue observing the isolated slow response while checks pass.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Переключение требует подтверждённого условия. Единичная задержка не разрешает даже временное переключение, а успешные проверки не делают дальнейшее наблюдение бессмысленным.
c1_intro.target_construction: Write a conditional technical procedure that distinguishes a trigger from insufficient evidence.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for an operational guide. Restore a backup only after confirming corrupted data; one missing report is not sufficient evidence. Make the trigger and caution clear.
Write 2-4 sentences for a release guide. Roll back when the agreed health check fails repeatedly, not after one delayed sample; specify the condition and what must be verified.

b2.prompt: A test compared two page designs. Design A received 100 visits and ten sign-ups; Design B received 100 visits and fifteen sign-ups. Which result is stated by the data?
options: Design B had five more sign-ups in this test.
Design B had fifteen more sign-ups than Design A in this test.
Design A had five more sign-ups than Design B in this test.
b2.explanation_ru: Данные показывают разницу пятнадцать минус десять; in this test ограничивает вывод наблюдавшейся проверкой.
b2.target_construction: Report a direct experimental comparison without adding unsupported explanation.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a trial summary. Two email versions each reached fifty people; one received eight replies and the other twelve. Report the observed result.

Write 2-4 sentences for a benchmark note. Two configurations processed the same sample; one took thirty seconds and the other twenty-four. Describe the comparison without assuming it applies to all workloads.

b2_plus.prompt: A study changes both the interface and the reminder schedule. Sign-ups rise. Why is it difficult to attribute the rise to the interface alone?
options: The reminder change makes the interface effect less important, so it need not be measured.
Two factors changed, so their separate effects were not isolated.
The increased sign-ups imply that one factor helped, but identify the interface as the stronger one.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Both ... and указывает на смешанные изменения; без их разделения нельзя установить самостоятельный эффект интерфейса.
b2_plus.target_construction: Identify a confounding change and explain the limit on causal attribution.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a research review. A trial changed pricing and onboarding together, then retention improved; explain the attribution problem and propose a more informative comparison.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineering team. A benchmark changed hardware and caching simultaneously; explain why the latency gain cannot be assigned to caching alone.

c1_intro.prompt: A small trial shows no clear difference between two flows. The team wants to claim equivalence, but the study was not designed to establish a sufficiently small difference. Which conclusion fits?
options: The trial supports equivalence provisionally, subject to confirmation with a larger sample.
The trial’s limited power suggests a meaningful difference is probably being hidden.
The trial is inconclusive on superiority and does not establish practical equivalence.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Неопределённость не является предварительным доказательством равенства или вероятного скрытого эффекта. Для практической эквивалентности нужен соответствующий критерий и дизайн.
c1_intro.target_construction: Distinguish an inconclusive result from evidence that alternatives are equivalent.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a product experiment review. A trial with twelve users found no clear difference between two flows; explain what remains uncertain before claiming equivalence.
Write 2-4 sentences for a technical benchmark summary. Three runs showed mixed timings with no clear winner; state the limited finding and why a stronger equivalence claim needs more evidence.

b2.prompt: An assistant drafts messages, but a person must check them before sending. Which description fits the workflow?
options: The assistant prepares drafts; a person reviews them before sending.
The assistant sends messages; a person checks them afterwards.
The assistant’s draft is checked only if a customer complains.
b2.explanation_ru: Drafts и before sending сохраняют роль инструмента как подготовки и обязательный человеческий контроль до отправки.
b2.target_construction: Describe an automation workflow and its human review point.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a customer-service team. A tool suggests reply drafts, but agents must check account facts before sending; explain the workflow.
Write 2-4 sentences to an engineering team. A tool generates test ideas, while developers decide which to implement; describe the tool’s role and the human decision.

b2_plus.prompt: A pilot says, "The tool reduced drafting time, though reviewers spent longer checking factual claims." Which summary is faithful?
options: Drafting became faster, so total effort fell despite longer checking.
Drafting became faster, but verification required more reviewer time.
Longer checking offset the drafting gain exactly, leaving total effort unchanged.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Though вводит компенсирующий эффект; ускорение одного этапа не доказывает сокращение всей работы.
b2_plus.target_construction: Assess automation across preparation and verification rather than one isolated step.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a manager. Automated summaries save preparation time, but staff spend extra time correcting names and dates; describe both effects and suggest measuring total effort.
Write 2-4 sentences for a developer trial report. Code suggestions arrive faster, but reviews identify more edge-case errors; explain why suggestion speed alone is an incomplete benefit measure.

c1_intro.prompt: An AI draft confidently names a rule and reads smoothly, but no source is verified. A colleague treats fluency as evidence of correctness. Which response best calibrates trust without dismissing the draft’s usefulness?
options: The fluency provides initial confidence; source checking can focus on details that sound uncertain.
Without verified sources, the draft’s clear wording should count against its credibility.
The wording may be useful, but confidence in the claim should come from checking an authoritative source.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Качество текста может быть полезным отдельно от истинности. Fluency не оправдывает выборочную проверку и не является отрицательным доказательством само по себе.
c1_intro.target_construction: Separate persuasive presentation from evidence of reliability in AI-assisted work.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague. An AI draft confidently names a regulation, but no source has been verified; explain what evidence is needed before using the claim.
Write 2-4 sentences for a team policy note. A generated technical explanation reads smoothly but has not been tested against system behaviour; explain how it should be treated pending verification.

b2.prompt: A policy allows sharing a report with approved project members only. Which action follows that rule?
options: Send it only to members whose project access is approved.
Send it to anyone involved in a related project, whether approved or not.
Send it to all company staff because some approved members work there.
b2.explanation_ru: Only ограничивает круг получателей подтверждённым доступом; интерес к проекту или просьба одного участника не расширяют разрешение.
b2.target_construction: Express a clear access restriction and identify the authorised audience.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a colleague. A customer file may be shared only with the assigned account team; explain why an unrelated team needs separate approval.
Write 2-4 sentences for an internal reminder. Production logs are available to authorised incident responders, while public screenshots must remove sensitive values; state the limits.

b2_plus.prompt: A security update says, "The patch reduces exposure but does not eliminate all risk." Which paraphrase preserves the claim?
options: Risk is lower, so controls addressing the remaining risk can now be relaxed.
Risk is lower after the patch, but some risk remains.
Remaining risk indicates that the patch’s reduction has yet to take effect.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Reduces и does not eliminate отделяют уменьшение риска от его полного отсутствия; остаточный риск сохраняется.
b2_plus.target_construction: Communicate a mitigation’s benefit without claiming complete protection.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a sponsor. Stronger authentication reduces the risk of stolen-password access, but users still need to protect recovery codes; explain the residual risk.
Write 2-4 sentences to a privacy review group. Removing direct identifiers reduces exposure, but rare combinations may still identify individuals; qualify the protection.

c1_intro.prompt: Reviewed logs show no unauthorised export, but a one-hour logging gap remains. Stakeholders ask for a statement that no export occurred. Which update matches the evidence?
options: No export is indicated, so the missing hour is unlikely to change the overall conclusion.
The logging gap means we cannot report any finding from the available logs.
No export is indicated in the available logs; the missing hour prevents a conclusion for that interval.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Узкий отрицательный вывод допустим по доступным данным. Неизвестный интервал нельзя оценить вероятностно без основания, но он не обнуляет наблюдения остальных логов.
c1_intro.target_construction: Explain a negative security finding together with an observability limitation.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to an incident stakeholder. Available logs show no data export, but one hour of logs is missing; communicate the finding and evidence gap without asserting a breach.
Write 2-4 sentences to a privacy officer. Reviewed accounts show no unexpected access, while an older archive has not yet been checked; report the scope and next step.

b2.prompt: At 10:00 requests began failing. At 10:15 traffic was moved to a healthy instance. At 10:30 checks showed recovery. Which handover follows the timeline?
options: Failures began at 10:00; traffic moved at 10:15; recovery was confirmed at 10:30.
Failures began at 10:00; recovery was confirmed at 10:15 when traffic moved.
Traffic moved at 10:00; failures began at 10:15; recovery was confirmed at 10:30.
b2.explanation_ru: Запись сохраняет последовательность симптома, вмешательства и проверки; действие и подтверждённое восстановление разделены.
b2.target_construction: Record incident chronology and distinguish action from verification.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a handover. An export queue stalled at 14:00, workers restarted at 14:10 and queued jobs cleared at 14:25; give the timeline and current state.
Write 2-4 sentences for an operational update. Errors appeared at 09:00, a configuration reverted at 09:20 and error rates normalised at 09:35; preserve the sequence.

b2_plus.prompt: A handover says, "Service is restored; the trigger is still unknown. Keep enhanced monitoring until 18:00." What remains required?
options: Continue monitoring until 18:00 only if the service fails again.
Continue enhanced monitoring despite restored service and an unknown trigger.
Use monitoring to confirm the known trigger, since service recovery establishes its cause.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Restored описывает состояние сервиса, unknown — знание причины; явное keep задаёт продолжающееся действие.
b2_plus.target_construction: Separate operational recovery from causal understanding and state the continuing action.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to the next shift. A retry restored deliveries, but the original timeout cause is unclear; state current status, the uncertainty and what to monitor.
Write 2-4 sentences for an incident handover. A backup endpoint is handling requests, while the primary remains under investigation; specify who owns the next check and what is unresolved.

c1_intro.prompt: A deployment and a dependency change both preceded an error spike by a few minutes. Logs have not isolated either cause. Which handover sentence keeps the investigation open and the timeline useful?
options: The deployment is the likely trigger because it preceded the spike, with the dependency as a secondary factor.
The two changes make chronology uninformative, so neither should be included as a working hypothesis.
The spike followed both changes; deployment is a hypothesis, with the dependency change still to be tested.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Порядок помогает гипотезам, но не ранжирует причины без дополнительного свидетельства. Совпадение двух изменений не делает саму хронологию бесполезной.
c1_intro.target_construction: Report a suspected incident cause while distinguishing chronology from established causation.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to an incoming responder. A configuration edit occurred ten minutes before failures, but another dependency also changed; state the hypothesis and evidence still needed.
Write 2-4 sentences to a stakeholder. Traffic rose shortly before the queue stalled, but resource data is incomplete; describe the known sequence without declaring a root cause.

b2.prompt: A review finds an alert was not sent because its rule was disabled. Which sentence focuses on the observed process failure?
options: The alert was not sent because the rule was disabled.
The team intentionally hid the incident by disabling the rule.
The alert was sent successfully despite the disabled rule.
b2.explanation_ru: Пассив описывает проверенное состояние и связь в процессе; он не добавляет неподтверждённое обвинение в намерении.
b2.target_construction: Describe an observed failure mechanism without inventing personal intent.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a retrospective. A handover omitted the rollback instruction, so the next shift spent time finding it; describe the process gap and a documentation action.
Write 2-4 sentences for a postmortem. A test did not cover expired tokens, so that case reached production; state the observed gap and a concrete test improvement.

b2_plus.prompt: A postmortem says, "The operator’s action triggered the failure, but missing safeguards allowed it to spread." What distinction is made?
options: The missing safeguards triggered the failure, while the operator’s action only increased its impact.
The immediate trigger differs from the conditions that amplified the impact.
The operator’s action is the root cause, with safeguards relevant only to unrelated future failures.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Triggered называет пусковое событие, allowed it to spread — способствующее условие; анализ не сводится к одному действию.
b2_plus.target_construction: Separate an immediate trigger from contributing system conditions.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for an incident review. A mistaken input triggered an error, and absent validation let it affect many records; distinguish the trigger and contributing safeguard gap.
Write 2-4 sentences for a retrospective. A late requirement change caused rework, while unclear ownership delayed its discovery; describe both layers and an improvement.

c1_intro.prompt: A team selected a supplier using positive references. A previously undisclosed capacity limit later caused failure. Which retrospective statement improves due diligence without assuming foreknowledge?
options: The failure shows capacity checks were an obvious requirement the team should have recognised then.
Because the limit was undisclosed, future selection checks are unlikely to address this kind of risk.
Capacity checks could strengthen future selection, though the past team did not have today’s failure evidence.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Урок использует новые данные для будущего, не выдавая их за доступные ранее. Obvious requirement добавляет hindsight bias, undisclosed не доказывает бесполезность нового контроля.
c1_intro.target_construction: Use hindsight to improve a process without attributing foreknowledge to past decisions.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a postmortem. A team chose a supplier using positive references, but an unknown capacity limit later caused failure; separate available knowledge from a future due-diligence improvement.

Write 2-4 sentences for an engineering review. An unusual failure mode was absent from previous tests and incident history; propose a safeguard without claiming engineers should have known the eventual outcome.

b2.prompt: A team is moving to a new process on Monday. Training is on Friday and the old process remains available for one week. Which announcement gives the transition accurately?
options: Train on Friday, start the new process on Monday, and keep the old one available for a week.
Train on Friday, start on Monday, and remove the old process immediately on Monday.
Start the new process on Friday and hold training the following Monday.
b2.explanation_ru: Три временных элемента сохранены: подготовка, начало изменения и ограниченный переходный период.
b2.target_construction: Explain a process change with preparation, start date and transition arrangements.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a customer team. A new booking form starts next Wednesday, with a walkthrough on Tuesday and the old form available until Friday; explain the transition.
Write 2-4 sentences to an internal team. A new review template starts in two weeks; examples are available now and the first submissions will receive extra help.

b2_plus.prompt: An update says, "Staff support the aim of the change, but question the proposed timetable." What should a summary distinguish?
options: General opposition to the change, expressed through a specific complaint about timing.
Agreement with the goal from concern about the implementation timing.
Conditional support for the goal that depends on keeping the proposed timetable.
b2_plus.explanation_ru: Support the aim / question the timetable разделяют отношение к цели и к способу внедрения; второе не отменяет первое.
b2_plus.target_construction: Represent stakeholder concerns accurately without treating implementation objections as rejection of the goal.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences to a programme sponsor. Staff welcome clearer reporting, but find the proposed two-day migration too short; summarise both views and propose discussing timing.
Write 2-4 sentences to a process owner. Engineers support stronger review checks, but worry the rollout overlaps a release freeze; distinguish agreement from the scheduling concern.

c1_intro.prompt: All staff use the new template because the old one is disabled. Feedback still reports confusion. Which evaluation separates required behaviour from genuine acceptance?
options: Consistent use suggests acceptance, with confusion mainly a remaining training detail.
Reported confusion means the behavioural switch should not yet count as adoption in any sense.
Required use confirms the behavioural switch; understanding and acceptance need separate evidence.
c1_intro.explanation_ru: Наблюдаемое использование подтверждает переход действий, а понимание и поддержка проверяются отдельно. Данные не дают назвать confusion второстепенным, но и не отменяют факт использования.
c1_intro.target_construction: Distinguish adoption behaviour from endorsement and identify evidence of acceptance.

production_prompts.prompt: Write 2-4 sentences for a change review. All teams submit the required template, but anonymous feedback reports confusion; explain what usage proves and what still needs attention.
Write 2-4 sentences to a leadership group. Staff log into a new tool because the old one closed, while voluntary use of advanced features remains low; distinguish compliance from meaningful uptake.
